name: Support desk
description: Answers customers and knows when to hand over.

role.line: Answers customers and knows when to hand over
brings: Skills for answering, handing over and filing bugs
Conversations, known issues and callbacks, as tables
A scorecard you check every Friday

wins.say: Here is our help center. Tell me the five questions it answers worst.
Draft replies to the open conversations in Intercom. Don’t send anything.
Read this week’s support channel and start the known issues list.

offers.title: Morning list
offers.detail: Each weekday, what came in overnight that needs a person
offers.instruction: List the customer conversations that came in since yesterday evening and need a person, newest first, one line each with a link. Draft nothing and send nothing to customers.

offers.title: Friday themes
offers.detail: Each Friday, what customers asked about most
offers.instruction: Write what customers asked about most this week, with counts and links, and add any problem reported more than once to known_issues using the bug-report skill.
